MRI-suspected high-grade glioma may enter screening. The study confirms the diagnosis with a minimally invasive tumor biopsy before treatment; biopsy costs are covered. All dogs receive ten radiation sessions and are randomized to temozolomide plus lomustine or placebo. Neurologic, organ-function, anesthesia and study-treatment suitability require Zurich assessment.
